explanation_or_example: Las literas son una forma de aprovechar el espacio.
example_english: Bunk beds are a way to save space.

spanish: manejar
english: to handle; to drive
explanation_or_example: No tengo ni idea de cómo manejar este problema.
example_english: I have no idea how to handle this problem.

spanish: admitir
english: to admit
explanation_or_example: Cuesta admitir un error, pero hacerlo permite corregirlo.
example_english: It is hard to admit a mistake, but doing so makes it possible to correct it.

spanish: abandonar
english: to abandon
explanation_or_example: El capitán dio la orden de abandonar el barco.
example_english: The captain gave the order to abandon the ship.

spanish: aplicar
english: to apply
explanation_or_example: Tom se hizo aplicar una inyección para la gripa.
example_english: Tom got a flu shot.

spanish: causar
english: to cause
explanation_or_example: Esto significó que eran demasiado débiles para causar más problemas.
example_english: This meant they were too weak to cause more trouble.

spanish: conceder
english: to grant
explanation_or_example: Tras revisar la solicitud, el juez optó por conceder la libertad provisional.
example_english: After reviewing the application, the judge chose to grant bail.

spanish: conservar
english: to conserve
explanation_or_example: Me gusta conservar mi ropa el máximo tiempo posible.
example_english: I like to keep my clothes for as long as possible.

spanish: contener
english: to contain
explanation_or_example: Tuve que contener la risa durante la representación.
example_english: I had to hold back my laughter during the performance.

spanish: contribuir
english: to contribute
explanation_or_example: Tom me preguntó si acaso estaría dispuesto a contribuir algo de dinero.
example_english: Tom asked me if I would be willing to contribute some money.

spanish: desaparecer
english: to disappear
explanation_or_example: Mi dinero parece desaparecer para el final de mes.
example_english: My money seems to disappear by the end of the month.

spanish: exigir
english: to demand; to require
explanation_or_example: Tenemos derecho a exigir un futuro seguro para nosotros y las generaciones futuras.
example_english: We have a right to demand a safe future for ourselves and future generations.

spanish: expresar
english: to express
explanation_or_example: No existen palabras para expresar lo increíble que eres.
example_english: No words can express how amazing you are.

spanish: indicar
english: to indicate
explanation_or_example: Las flechas azules van a indicar la salida más cercana.
example_english: The blue arrows will indicate the nearest exit.
